Interested candidates with strong inclination towards research and development may attend walk-in interview
proposed on 16th December, 2024 at 11 AM at Centre for Academics, CSJM University Campus. The
candidates should present themselves before the interview board with all original documents, a copy of bio-data
and 2- sets of self- attested photocopies of all relevant marksheets and certificates.
Note:
1. No TA/DA is admissible for appearance in the interview.
2. The terms and conditions for the appointment of Project assistants would be as per regulations
mentioned by UPHEC and CSJM University, Kanpur.
